One transparent 256×256 Broodfall Sniper RED animation sprite.
Image 1 is the APPROVED TEAL EDIT TARGET, absolute pose, geometry, scale and silhouette authority. Image 2 is the APPROVED RED STATIC color/material reference ONLY.
Make an exact red-team palette counterpart of Image 1. Replace aqua/teal painted helmet/cowl, shoulders, torso and small weapon armor accents with the approved bright weathered crimson red from Image 2. Preserve taupe cloak, charcoal undersuit, pale worn metal, amber optic and all unpainted components. Do not recolor cloak red.

Requested pose: DEATH 1 HIT/STAGGER. Preserve tilted torso, uneven bent legs, long rifle aiming slightly north-west and the exact spread cloak. Approx normalized bbox x78–177 y14–242. Change team paint only.
